select ar.id, user_code, score, scoreL, state, age, if(sex = 1, '女', '男') as sex, qtime, answer, is_falg, assess from yh_assess_result ar left join yh_assess_concent ac on ar.assess = ac.id where user_code = #{userCode} and ac.name = #{assess,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and is_falg = 2 order by qtime desc limit 1

select reg.user_code, reg.name, reg.mobile, `count`, qtime from yh_user_reginfo as reg inner join yh_user_make_card as mc on reg.user_code = mc.user_code
inner join ( select auqa.user_code from yh_assess_result as auqa inner join ( select user_code, max(qtime) as qtime, assess from yh_assess_result group by user_code, assess ) as aid on aid.user_code = auqa.user_code and aid.qtime = auqa.qtime and aid.assess = auqa.assess
(auqa.state = #{item.assstate} and auqa.assess = #{item.assid})
group by auqa.user_code ) as ast on ast.user_code = reg.user_code
left join ( select user_code,DATE_FORMAT(max(qtime),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as qtime,count(1) as `count` from yh_assess_result group by user_code ) as asr on asr.user_code = reg.user_code where reg.User_Type = 5 and doctor = (select id from yh_user_admin_info where user_code = #{doctor})
and ( reg.user_code like CONCAT('%',#{userCode},'%') or reg.name like CONCAT('%',#{userCode},'%') or reg.mobile like CONCAT('%',#{userCode},'%') )
and reg.Org_Code like CONCAT('%',#{treeOrg},'%')
and DATE_FORMAT(qtime, '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(#{timeMin}, '%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(#{timeMax}, '%Y-%m-%d')
order by qtime desc
order by qtime asc
